messages.content: Hi! How can I help you today?

Hi, this is Lucas Brown. I need to change the date of my flight in reservation EUJUY6. My wife tragically passed away yesterday, and I need to move the flight out by two days. Can you please help me with this?
I'm very sorry for your loss, Lucas. I'll help with the change. First, could you please provide your user ID?
Thank you for your condolences. My user ID is lucas_brown_4047. I really need to move the flight by two days due to this difficult situation.

Lucas, I'm very sorry about your wife. I wish I had better news.

I can't change the dates on reservation EUJUY6, for two reasons:

- **Fare type:** The reservation is basic economy, and basic economy flights can't be modified.
- **Flights already flown:** The first part of the trip (ORD → DEN → LAS on 2024-05-14) has already been flown. That also rules out changing the cabin to make the reservation modifiable.

Is there anything else I can help you with?

I understand the restrictions, but this is a really difficult time for me. Is there absolutely no way to make an exception and just move the flight by two days? I don't want to cancel, just change the date. Please, is there anything you can do?

Lucas, I'm truly sorry. I know this is an incredibly hard time, but I can't make an exception. Basic economy reservations can't be modified, and part of this trip has already been flown. I can't move the flights on this reservation, even by two days.

I can help with other things on your account if you'd like.
I appreciate your understanding. Since the flight date can't be changed, I guess there's nothing more to do. Thank you for your help. ###STOP###
